name: Miyazaki

queries.query: Japan official cadastral parcel map API Miyazaki City parcel polygons registry map
queries.result: Found the official Ministry of Justice map-data publication route and a Miyazaki-specific catalog record; the public catalog exposes metadata and login-gated ZIP resources, not an anonymous bounded feature API.

queries.result: Found the Miyazaki municipal map viewer, the municipal cadastral-survey explanation, and the Ministry of Justice Miyazaki registry-map catalog record. The municipal viewer is not a parcel polygon service; the catalog ZIP downloads require login.

portalsFound.observation: Current Miyazaki City GIS portal; current portal HTML and simple.js expose road, building-law road, hazard, water, sewer, and planning entrypoints. No cadastral parcel layer or parcel API was exposed in the inspected files.

Ministry of Justice-maintained Miyazaki City (Miyazaki Legal Affairs Bureau) registry-office map dataset. Metadata lists 45201-3500-2025.zip and 45201-3500-2026.zip in Map XML format; catalog metadata says download requires login.
Miyazaki City explains that cadastral-survey maps and books are sent to the Legal Affairs Bureau as registry-office maps; this is explanatory/procedural evidence, not an open parcel endpoint.

requests.assessment: Official current portal landing page retrieved with Chrome User-Agent, Accept, Accept-Language: ja,en;q=0.8, cookie jar, and TLS verification.
Official viewer JavaScript inspected. It routes to map entrypoints and contains no FeatureServer, MapServer, WFS, WMS, or parcel API URL.

Official G空間情報センター CKAN metadata response. It identifies Ministry of Justice as maintainer, format as Map XML, and resources 45201-3500-2025.zip / 45201-3500-2026.zip; catalog extras state download requires login. No parcel features returned.

Attempted prior hosted touki layer used for other Japanese regions, with Miyazaki municipality code 45201 and ID+geometry fields only. Request did not complete within the bounded timeout; this is temporary/unavailable evidence only and is not treated as citywide absence.
Not downloaded because the catalog identifies the resource as login-gated; no credentials or login attempt was used.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Miyazaki City registry-office map data published by the Ministry of Justice through the G空間情報センター catalog; metadata footprint covers Miyazaki City.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No open parcel polygon response verified. The municipal viewer and catalog metadata were verified only as discovery leads.

remainingUncertainty: The Ministry of Justice dataset is a strong city-specific source lead, but its downloadable Map XML resources were login-gated during this attempt and no anonymous feature endpoint was disclosed. The city viewer may expose additional services after a consent subpage or through browser interactions not present in the inspected landing-page JavaScript. A timeout against an unrelated hosted layer is not evidence of absence. No owner, address, titleholder, tax, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently test whether the Ministry of Justice Map XML resource can be accessed under an authorized public-data workflow, or inspect the municipal consent subpages and browser network calls for a current public parcel service. Keep runtimeReadiness held until an independent bounded ID+geometry sample qualifies.
